subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words.

Something to be easily carried or moved
solution:
The correct answer is: **Portable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The statement "Something to be easily carried or moved" describes an object that can be transported or relocated with minimal effort. 

 
 
• **Example: **A laptop is designed to be carried around, making it a perfect example of this description.
 
 

 
• The word **"Portable"** specifically refers to an item that is designed to be easily carried or moved from one place to another. (पोर्टेबल)

 
 
• **Example: **Thanks to its compact and lightweight design, the portable speaker can be taken anywhere, from the beach to the park.
 
 

 
• Hence, the correct one-word substitute for "Something to be easily carried or moved" is **'Portable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Portable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Robust **(मजबूत): Exhibiting strength or a strong constitution.

 
 
• **Example:** The robust construction of the building ensured it could withstand severe weather conditions.
 
 

 
• **Stagnant **(स्थिर): Showing no activity; dull or sluggish.

 
 
• **Example: **The stagnant water in the pond became a breeding ground for mosquitoes.
 
 

 
• **Fragile** (नाजुक): Easily broken or damaged.

 
 
• **Example:** The fragile glassware was carefully packed to avoid any damage during transportation.
